Overview
Simplify the process of hiring and managing contingent workers with generative AI capabilities for more effective talent sourcing and workflow automation tools to streamline the lifecycle of each job request.
Initiate
Use AI to automatically create job descriptions that include necessary skills, key terms, and content such as mission statements while avoiding unconscious bias. Use rate cards to enforce bill rates.
Collaborate with stakeholders on requisition details and approve only when all compliance standards are met. Translate job postings into multiple languages and provide language support across all regions.
Send requisitions that are configured by position, unit, or labor category to direct sourcing platforms and/or an MSP. Target the most appropriate vendors first.
Use AI to automatically create job descriptions that include necessary skills, key terms, and content such as mission statements while avoiding unconscious bias. Use rate cards to enforce bill rates.

Engage
Interview, evaluate, and negotiate offers with a single solution to engage the best candidates for every job posting.
Review potential candidates according to their status, such as active job seekers, active workers, workers reaching the end date of their current engagement, and workers in a talent pool.
Assign and track completion of all role-specific onboarding tasks such as NDA signatures, asset receipts, access passes, and safety training courses.
Interview, evaluate, and negotiate offers with a single solution to engage the best candidates for every job posting.

Step 1 of 3

Manage
Manage tasks for your entire global workforce, including onboarding, timesheet approval, and invoicing within a centralized system.
Review and approve or reject external workforce timesheets and all applicable premiums in one place.
Simplify invoice and payment tracking by automatically generating invoices based on approved timesheets and viewing more detailed remittance information.
Manage tasks for your entire global workforce, including onboarding, timesheet approval, and invoicing within a centralized system.

Complete
Quickly and securely complete the engagement using automated processes to offboard your contingent workers.
Evaluate workers with performance feedback and close the assignment.
Review analytics on vendor performance using automatically generated KPIs such as response time, cycle time, and hire rate. Start planning for next assignments.
